closest_four.why_selected: UBE3A restoration in Angelman; pediatric neurodevelopment, intrathecal dosing, cognition/function assessment. Failed pivotal provides disconfirming evidence.
closest_four.key_mismatch: Imprinted paternal allele unsilencing; three Angelman assets share disease/target and are correlated.

closest_four.key_mismatch: Angelman/UBE3A correlation; EEG biomarker is not established SYNGAP1 efficacy surrogate.

closest_four.key_mismatch: Angelman/UBE3A correlation; positive early uncontrolled signals are not demonstrated pivotal success.

closest.interpretation: Selected-sample outcome bounds, NOT population PoS or confidence intervals; stops assumed permanent; no independence assumed.

model: p_adjusted = p0*M / (1-p0+p0*M). M is an assumed net odds multiplier, NOT an estimated likelihood ratio. Benchmarks are alternative anchors, not independent observations.
reason: Incomplete selected cohorts; unresolved outcomes; correlated disease/target clusters; stage mismatch. No valid numerical incremental likelihood identified.
recency: Recent close peers primary mechanistic evidence; older successes supporting delivery/platform evidence only. No arbitrary date-weighting of unresolved outcomes. No verified current-regime broad probability obtained.
